verdict.rationale: Evidence describes generic AI agents, automation of the sales cycle, and 24/7 autonomous task handling (e.g. salesforce-docs-18, salesforce-docs-21), but nothing documents an ability to schedule recurring jobs/workflows (e.g. cron-like scheduled Apex, scheduled Flows, or agent job scheduling) for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: documentation of recurring/scheduled automation configuration, API or CLI support for scheduling jobs, and any hands-on confirmation that Agentforce agents can be set to run on a recurring cadence.
